name: Northern Jatizso and Neitiznot
accessNote: Requires The Fremennik Trials to reach Jatizso/Neitiznot via Mord Gunnars; The Fremennik Isles does not need completion to start access. Contains 15 female, 14 male, 4 grunt, and 19 runt ice trolls. Bring prayer and a Neitiznot shield to reduce damage from ice troll females; Jatizso bank is slightly closer than Neitiznot.
